notes: Sources: one usable file, 2018_00_link (TTIC Faculty Handbook, 'Revised September 2014'; Wayback capture 2016-08-27 for a 2018-02-28 row).

Version: the handbook states 'Revised September 2014' and the copy dates from August 2016, before the reference academic year 2017-18; whether it was still the version in force on 2018-02-28 cannot be confirmed from the saved sources, so every component carries version_uncertain.

The handbook's Important Note says it is 'presented for information purposes only', is 'not a contract', and that 'the formal and full rule policy statements control', available from Administration. Those statements are not saved (cross_reference_not_saved on every component). The general disclaimer was not read as disclaiming the specific grants.

Other documents named but not saved: TTIC Promotion and Tenure policy (Intranet); full sabbatical policy (Intranet, Benefits Policies); Teaching Agreement with the University of Chicago; Academic Program Guide; IP policy document; mentorship policy document; travel policy document; Policy on Academic Fraud; tuition benefit policy; health plan summary plan descriptions. Only the P&T policy bears on a component (c8, c9).

Not components: sick leave ('Faculty members do not accrue sick leave'; an ill faculty member arranges coverage of the quarter's responsibilities with the CAO, no leave or pay stated); Emergency Faculty Absences (colleague covers a class); the leave of absence and part-time status for outside professional or commercial activities (purpose not usable for a birth); sabbatical; military leave and jury duty (cannot be used for a birth); health insurance continuation during leave.
No statute relevant to becoming a parent is named (no FMLA, no Illinois leave law); the US FMLA floor applies through statutory_floor (U7).
Calendar: quarter system; final examinations in the eleventh week; term_weeks 11 (R8 quarter default).

Birth parent chain: parental leave c1 (one quarter, full pay) OR child care leave c2 (12 weeks unpaid) [in_lieu_of]; maternity/own-health leave c4 (up to 12 weeks, unlinked to c1/c2) with STD c5 concurrent_with c4; all leaves capped at 12 weeks in total by the General Leave Policies (leave_limits); LTD c6 after three months of disability; then a discretionary personal leave c10 (general purpose).

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave c1 if primary care giver OR child care leave c2 OR teaching rearrangement c7 (other, not relief) [each in_lieu_of c1]; caregiver's leave c3 for the birth parent's serious health condition (unlinked); 12-week total cap across c1-c4 (leave_limits).

Tenure clock: automatic one-year extension per birth or adoption for an assistant professor with equal or primary care-giving responsibilities (c8); a one-time discretionary extension for own illness or family care (c9).

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
